name: std::basic_const_iterator
intro: std::basic_const_iterator is an iterator adaptor which behaves exactly like the underlying iterator (which must be at least an LegacyInputIterator or model input_iterator), except that dereferencing converts the value returned by the underlying iterator as immutable. Specializations of std::basic_const_iterator are constant iterators, that is, the iterator can never be used as an output iterator because modifying elements is not allowed.

sections.text:
template< std::input_iterator I >

using const_iterator = /* see description */;
  
 (since C++23)

If I models constant-iterator (an exposition-only concept), then const_iterator<I> denotes a type I. Otherwise, basic_const_iterator<I>.

template< std::semiregular S >

using const_sentinel = /* see description */;
  
 (since C++23)

If S models input_iterator, then const_sentinel<S> denotes a type const_iterator<S>. Otherwise, S.
